'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Afghanistan–United States relations]], [[Afghan peace process]]
***The [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]] orders a portion of their staff to leave the [[Embassy of the United States, Kabul|Kabul embassy]] as a step of [[2021 withdrawal of U.S. troops from Afghanistan|withdrawing]] [[United States Armed Forces|troops]] from [[Afghanistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-kabul-government-and-politics-afghanistan-a404b0c61efe5b752c39f82ff6f161c2 (AP)]
*[[2021 Northern Chad offensive|Northern Chad offensive]]
**At least four people in [[N'Djamena]] and one in [[Moundou]] are killed during protests requesting the military [[government of Chad|government]] to concede to a civilian transition. Police use [[tear gas]] to disperse protesters. The military council has banned protests. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/27/protests-erupt-in-chads-capital-protesters-demand-civilian-rule (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]], [[Karen conflict]]
**The [[Karen National Union]] attacks an army outpost near the [[Myanmar–Thailand border]] at dawn. The [[Tatmadaw|Myanmar military]] retaliates with airstrikes as some 450 [[Thai people|Thai]] villagers are moved to safety by the [[Thai military]]. There are no immediate reports of casualties. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/fighting-erupts-myanmar-near-thai-border-thai-witnesses-2021-04-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Saudi Arabia]] says that it detected and destroyed an incoming [[Unmanned surface vehicle|remote-controlled ship]] containing explosives in the [[Red Sea]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/saudi-arabia-port-explosion-iran-talks-b1838156.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2021 Quincentennial Commemorations in the Philippines]]
**The [[Philippines]] celebrates the 500th anniversary of the [[Battle of Mactan]], where Filipino natives led by chieftain [[Lapulapu]] killed Portuguese explorer [[Ferdinand Magellan]]. [https://www.philstar.com/lifestyle/arts-and-culture/2021/04/26/2093944/battle-mactan-500th-anniversary-historian-shares-10-facts (''The Philippine Star)''] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
*****The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|CDC]] says that fully vaccinated Americans can go outside without wearing a mask unless they are in large crowds. [https://apnews.com/article/cdc-mask-wearing-guidance-d373775ddcf237764c19ff9428b59634 (AP)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colorado]]
*****[[Colorado]] surpasses 500,000 cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.denverpost.com/2021/04/27/colorado-half-million-covid-cases-hospitalizations/ (''The Denver Post'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Massachusetts]]
*****[[Governor of Massachusetts|Massachusetts Governor]] [[Charlie Baker]] receives his second dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.wwlp.com/news/massachusetts/gov-baker-gets-second-covid-19-vaccine-dose/ (WWLP-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec]] reports [[Canada]]'s first death from a vaccination. The death has been linked to a [[thrombosis|blood clot]] after a 54-year-old woman received the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] and died due to [[cerebral venous sinus thrombosis]]. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7812813/quebec-covid19-april-27-2021/ (''Global News'')]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Canada]]
*****[[Canadian Army]] [[Major general#Canada|general]] [[Dany Fortin]], the person in charge of [[Canada]]'s vaccination campaign, receives his first dose of the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/politics/maj-gen-fortin-gets-the-jab-canadian-military-using-moderna-to-immunize-its-troops-1.5404563 (CTV News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Sweden]]
*****[[Sweden|Swedish]] [[Prime Minister of Sweden|Prime Minister]] [[Stefan Löfven]] receives his first dose of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer–BioNTech]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-sweden-pm/swedish-pm-given-covid-19-vaccine-urges-population-to-follow-suit-idUSL1N2MK1V0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Iceland]] bans unnecessary travel from high-risk areas in an attempt to reduce the spread of COVID-19 infections. This ban applies to all international travelers and will be in effect until May 31. [https://icelandmonitor.mbl.is/news/nature_and_travel/2021/04/27/ban_on_non_essential_travel_from_high_risk_areas_to/ (Iceland Monitor)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Portugal]] reports its first six cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant originally detected in [[India]]. [https://www.theportugalnews.com/news/2021-04-27/six-cases-of-indian-variant-detected-in-portugal/59553 (The Portugal News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] grants an emergency use authorization for the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2021/04/27/bangladesh-approves-russia-s-sputnik-v-vaccine-for-emergency-use (''Dhaka Tribune'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]], [[Lineage B.1.351]]
****[[Iran]] reports its first three cases of the Lineage B.1.351 variant first discovered in [[South Africa]]. The Health Ministry warns of "harder days ahead" as it is predicted that the number of deaths due to COVID-19 will increase. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/iran-sees-first-cases-of-south-african-covid-19-variant/2222213 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record 15 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 163. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2106295/thai-covid-deaths-hit-new-record-tuesday (''Bangkok Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]]'s National Command and Operation Centre announces a ban on all tourism between May 8 and May 16 following a third wave of COVID-19. The country also bans all intercity and interprovincial travel during the [[Eid al-Fitr]] holidays, with the exception of travel within [[Gilgit-Baltistan]]. [https://www.thenews.com.pk/amp/826910-pakistan-to-place-full-ban-on-tourism-from-may-8-16 (''The News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[COVID-19 lockdowns|Lockdown]] restrictions are lifted in [[Perth]], [[Western Australia]], after no new community transmissions are reported. However, some indoor venues will remain closed, and the mask mandate will continue. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-04-26/no-new-coronavirus-cases-as-wa-covid-19-lockdown-ends/100094918 (ABC Australia)]
****[[Australia]] suspends flights from [[India]] until May 15 amidst a surge of the COVID-19 cases. [https://www.9news.com.au/national/australia-to-suspend-flights-coming-from-india-due-to-covid19-wave/ebd70c45-160b-4cbf-a87d-89e1f704837c (9 News)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Fiji]] reports its first six cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant originally detected in [[India]]. [https://www.tvnz.co.nz/one-news/world/fiji-health-officials-confirm-latest-six-covid-cases-variant-first-detected-in-india (TVNZ)]
*More than 27,000 barrels containing [[DDT]] insecticide are discovered in a 36,000 acre "dump-site" in the [[Gulf of Santa Catalina]]. Usage of DDT has been banned worldwide since 1972 due to the chemical's catastrophic effect on human and environmental health. [https://www.nbcnews.com/science/environment/25000-barrels-ddt-dump-site-pacific-scientists-say-rcna769 (NBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*The [[United States Navy]] says that three Iranian [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy]] patrol boats approach the [[USS Firebolt|USS ''Firebolt'']] at "an unnecessarily close range with unknown intent" and retreat after warning shots are fired. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/u-s-navy-fires-warning-shots-on-3-iranian-fast-boats (Fox News)]
*[[Brexit]], [[Trade negotiation between the UK and the EU]]
**The [[European Parliament]] ratifies the [[EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement]] with the [[United Kingdom]] by a 660–5 vote, with 32 [[Member of the European Parliament|MEPs]] abstaining. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-56899831 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Palestine relations]]
**A report published by [[Human Rights Watch]] accuses [[Israel]] of committing a [[crime of apartheid]] against the [[Palestinians|Palestinian people]]. [https://apnews.com/article/west-bank-race-and-ethnicity-middle-east-israel-jerusalem-7fc491f53d6e659d7fb9657e76747d03 (AP)]
*The [[European Parliament]] votes to lift the [[parliamentary immunity|immunity]] of [[far-right politics|far-right]] [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]] [[Ioannis Lagos]], who was sentenced to 13 years in prison in 2020 for being a leader of [[Golden Dawn (Greece)|Golden Dawn]], a party linked to acts of [[racism|racist]] and [[political violence]]. [[Belgian police]] arrest Lagos ahead of his likely extradition to [[Greece]]. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/world/europe/far-right-greek-mep-ioannis-lagos-detained-in-brussels-1.1212294 (''The National'' Abu Dhabi)]
*Postal workers of Spanish [[Correos]] intercept a letter with bullets mailed to [[President of the Community of Madrid|Madrid President]] [[Isabel Díaz Ayuso]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/spain-vote-madrid-bullets-idUSL8N2ML2GY (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Albanian parliamentary election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Albania|Prime Minister]] [[Edi Rama]] claims victory for his [[Socialist Party of Albania|Socialist Party]], making Rama the first Albanian prime minister to win three consecutive parliamentary elections. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/albania-pm-hails--sweetest--election-victory-14706070 (CNA)]
